caption:
The climb through the cloud forest is never about speed. It is about the rhythm you find when the road turns to gravel and the canopy closes in overhead. There is no engine to rely on here, only the weight of the bike and the steady turn of the pedals against the incline. When the forest is this thick, the noise of the world disappears, leaving you with nothing but the sound of your own breath and the gravel shifting beneath your tires.
